name: io.github.fmadore/iwac-mcp-server
title: Islam West Africa Collection (IWAC)
description: Read-only access to the Islam West Africa Collection via Hugging Face datasets.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Islam West Africa Collection across newspaper articles, Islamic publications, archival documents, academic references, audiovisual recordings, photographs, and the authority index (persons/places/organisations/events/subjects). Pass ONE concept or name — e.g. 'Tijaniyya', 'laïcité', 'Sheikh Gumi', 'pèlerinage'. Matching is accent- and case-insensitive; a multi-word query requires every word to appear somewhere in the item, so prefer a single concept per call. Press, publications, documents and index are in French, so French terms are what match them. Academic references are multilingual (French and English titles/abstracts); metadata/filter labels are French. Islamic terms appear in French transliteration (Tabaski not 'Eid al-Adha', charia not 'sharia', Maouloud not 'Mawlid'). Returns {results:[{id,title,url,category}], ranking}; each result's `category` names its subset and the `ranking` field documents the ordering. Pass an id to `fetch` to read the full text. For filtered queries (by country, date, or newspaper) use the search_* tools instead.

query.description: One concept, name, or short phrase; use French concept terms for primary sources, and French/English terms for references

limit.description: Max results across all categories. Default 20, max 50.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the full text and metadata of one IWAC item by an id returned from `search` (format '<category>:<number>', e.g. 'articles:28576'). Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata}: `text` is the item's OCR / abstract / transcription / description, `url` is the canonical islam.zmo.de link to cite, and `metadata` holds the remaining fields (author, date, country, newspaper, AI sentiment, …). Categories: articles, publications, references, documents, index, audiovisual, images.

id.description: Item id from search, e.g. 'articles:28576' or 'references:11045'

tools.name: explore_corpus
tools.description: Selection workbench: items, concordance, coverage, compare (requires comparison), attention, aliases, or paginated manifest/CSL-JSON/BibTeX exports. Exact filters intersect. limit/offset also page compare/coverage/attention cells. Coverage measures archive availability. Exports identify this page and dataset snapshot; compare snapshot IDs across pages. Schema discovery: iwac://datasets/{subset}.

country.description: Exact country name (accents optional)

keyword_mode.description: literal: the whole keyword as one substring

exact.description: AND values. Fields: subject/spatial/author/language/country/newspaper/topic_id/min_prob/scored_by; country_raw=whole cell; polarity:<model>.

country.description: Exact country name (accents optional)

keyword_mode.description: literal: the whole keyword as one substring

exact.description: AND values. Fields: subject/spatial/author/language/country/newspaper/topic_id/min_prob/scored_by; country_raw=whole cell; polarity:<model>.

link.description: Export modes: link the whole selection (≤5000) as one file instead of a page

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search IWAC newspaper articles by keyword (title + OCR + AI abstracts, French and English), country, newspaper, subject, and date range. The press is French; English terms match only the English abstract. Matching is accent- and case-insensitive.

keyword_mode.description: literal: the whole keyword as one substring

exact.description: AND values. Fields: subject/spatial/author/language/country/newspaper/topic_id/min_prob/scored_by; country_raw=whole cell; polarity:<model>.

keyword.description: Concept keyword; every word must occur (any order) in the title, OCR or French/English AI abstracts; "quote" a phrase. Prefer French for the OCR; an English term still matches via the English abstract

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Togo (accents optional)

hijri_month.description: Islamic lunar month: 1-12, or a name (Ramadan, Chaabane, Chawwal, Dhu al-Hijja). Pulls the articles behind an observance peak — matches only items with a full YYYY-MM-DD date.

with_description.description: Include each article's ~500-char AI abstract (description_ai) for triage without get_article. Adds ~125 tokens/row, so `limit` defaults to 10 and caps at 25 while this is on.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one article (by id): full metadata, the AI abstract (description_ai), AI sentiment, and OCR text, in 25k-char parts (follow `next_offset`). Pass a `keyword` to get ~2000-char excerpts around each match instead.

keyword.description: Return excerpts around matches instead of the full OCR (accent-insensitive)

offset.description: Read from this character on: the previous part's next_offset

tools.name: semantic_search_articles
tools.description: Semantic search over article title + full text, including articles whose OCR is not public. Query in any language. Runs the corpus model, EmbeddingGemma 2, locally with no API key (first use downloads ~350 MB). similarity_score only ranks within one query.

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Togo (accents optional)

tools.name: search_by_sentiment
tools.description: Filter articles by claude-haiku-5-5 sentiment labels (accent/case-insensitive exact match). One model's reading, not a consensus — 5 other models scored the same articles and often disagree; get_sentiment_distribution with model:"all" shows by how much. `subjectivity` is much the weakest of the three scales, so a set selected on it is a lead to read, not a finding.

polarity.description: Très positif | Positif | Neutre | Négatif | Très négatif | Non applicable

centrality.description: Très central | Central | Secondaire | Marginal | Non abordé

subjectivity.description: Très objectif | Plutôt objectif | Mixte | Plutôt subjectif | Très subjectif — least to most subjective. Unscored where the model answered Non abordé, so this filter also excludes those.

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Togo (accents optional)

disputed.description: polarite | centralite | subjectivite — keep only articles the panel SPLIT on for that field (French field names, as stored). Selects contested readings, not a sentiment value.

tools.name: get_sentiment_distribution
tools.description: Aggregate AI labels over a shared selection. model:"all" compares independent annotators and their coverage; model:"consensus" reads the stored panel majority. compare_models and agreement_field give pairwise Cohen's kappa and quadratic weighted kappa, with explicit denominators. Labels are interpretations, not ground truth; subjectivity is weak evidence, and results carry its caveat.

country.description: Exact country name (accents optional)

keyword_mode.description: literal: the whole keyword as one substring

exact.description: AND values. Fields: subject/spatial/author/language/country/newspaper/topic_id/min_prob/scored_by; country_raw=whole cell; polarity:<model>.

model.description: gpt-5-6-luna | mistral-small-2603 | deepseek-v4-flash-0731 | gemma-4-31b-it | qwen3-8-27b | claude-haiku-5-5 | all | consensus; default claude-haiku-5-5. Vendor aliases accepted; retired models rejected.

compare_models.description: Pair of model IDs or aliases; requires model:"all"

tools.name: search_index
tools.description: Search the IWAC authority index (persons, places, organisations, events, subjects) by name. Accent/case-insensitive.

keyword.description: Every word must occur in the entry title (any order); "quote" a phrase, or give a whole alternate title

index_type.description: Exact type (accents optional), validated against: Personnes | Lieux | Organisations | Événements | Sujets | Notices d'autorité. An unrecognised value returns an error listing the valid types.

tools.name: get_index_entry
tools.description: Get full details of an index entry by id (raw dataset columns, French names — Titre, Prénom, Coordonnées…).

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: List sujets from the IWAC index, sorted by frequency (most-referenced first).

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List lieux from the IWAC index, sorted by frequency (most-referenced first). The optional 'country' filter selects entries that APPEAR IN records from that country (mentioned-in, not located-in), ranked by collection-wide 'frequency' — so foreign and cross-border entries can appear. Nigeria reaches only the few entries its references mention (index frequency counts articles, publications and references; no article is Nigerian).

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional). Selects lieux MENTIONED IN records from that country, not entities located there

tools.name: list_persons
tools.description: List personnes from the IWAC index, sorted by frequency (most-referenced first). The optional 'country' filter selects entries that APPEAR IN records from that country (mentioned-in, not located-in), ranked by collection-wide 'frequency' — so foreign and cross-border entries can appear. Nigeria reaches only the few entries its references mention (index frequency counts articles, publications and references; no article is Nigerian).

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional). Selects personnes MENTIONED IN records from that country, not entities located there

tools.name: get_collection_stats
tools.description: Overall statistics for every IWAC subset, including `fulltext_coverage` — how many items in each subset actually carry searchable full text in this dataset: a keyword count is a full-text census only within that coverage.

tools.name: get_newspaper_stats
tools.description: Per-newspaper article counts and date ranges.

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Togo (accents optional)

tools.name: get_country_comparison
tools.description: Compare article counts, newspaper counts, date ranges, and claude-haiku-5-5 polarity across countries.

tools.name: get_temporal_distribution
tools.description: Counts by Gregorian or Hijri year/month, or pooled lunar month. Group by country/newspaper. Partial dates and missing lunar dates are disclosed. normalize_by returns numerator counts and per-bucket denominators in the same country/outlet/date scope, removing thematic filters. Shares describe IWAC holdings.

normalize_by.description: Share per bucket in the same country/outlet/date scope; searchable restricts both counts to full text. Thematic filters are removed from the denominator.

subset.description: articles (default) | publications | references | documents | audiovisual | images

granularity.description: year (default) | month | lunar_month (all years collapsed into 12 lunar months; needs calendar=hijri)

group_by.description: country | newspaper — one distribution per group value

Corpus-wide candidate generation belongs offline.

tools.description: Text length, lexical richness and readability by country/newspaper/year. Metrics are precomputed; readability is French-specific and excludes other languages. Missing values are disclosed. Distributions are descriptive evidence.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search Islamic publications (periodical issues, books). `keyword` matches title, subject, table of contents, and full OCR text (TOC hits come back as matching_toc_entries); publications are in French, so French terms are what match. Filter by newspaper/series, subject, country and year. Use list_periodicals to discover series titles, and get_publication_fulltext for keyword excerpts from a single issue.

keyword_mode.description: literal: the whole keyword as one substring

exact.description: AND values. Fields: subject/spatial/author/language/country/newspaper/topic_id/min_prob/scored_by; country_raw=whole cell; polarity:<model>.

tools.name: semantic_search_publications
tools.description: Semantic search over publication tables of contents, present for ~40% of issues (none for An-Nasr Vendredi, 130 of 695 Islam Info issues): use search_publications for the rest. Rows show the first 600 characters of each table. Query in any language. Runs the corpus model, EmbeddingGemma 2, locally with no API key (first use downloads ~350 MB). similarity_score only ranks within one query.

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Togo (accents optional)

tools.name: search_references
tools.description: Search academic references (journal articles, book chapters, theses, books, reports) by keyword and metadata. `keyword` requires every word in the title + abstract ("quote" a phrase). References are multilingual: try French and English title/abstract keywords when relevant; metadata/filter values such as `reference_type` and `language` use French labels. Results include a short abstract snippet — use get_reference for the full abstract and bibliographic detail.

keyword.description: French or English concept keyword; every word must occur in the title + abstract; "quote" a phrase

reference_type.description: Substring match. Values: Article de revue | Chapitre de livre | Livre | Mémoire de maitrise | Rapport | Thèse de doctorat | Communication scientifique | Compte rendu de livre | Article d'encyclopédie | Mémoire de licence | Article de blog | Working paper. Use the full label for precision — 'Livre' alone also matches 'Chapitre de livre' and 'Compte rendu de livre'.

subject.description: Subject tag (sparse: ~27% of references are tagged)

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional)

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Full bibliographic record for one academic reference (by id), including the complete abstract (present for ~51% of references), subjects, DOI/URL, and host-work details (book, volume, issue, pages).

tools.name: semantic_search_references
tools.description: Semantic search over academic references by title + abstract, across languages. Only references with an abstract (about half) are covered; use search_references for the rest. Runs the corpus model, EmbeddingGemma 2, locally with no API key (first use downloads ~350 MB). similarity_score only ranks within one query.

reference_type.description: French type label, substring (e.g. Thèse de doctorat)

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional)

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search the small archival-documents subset (~26 items: Islamic association reports, flyers, project documents — mostly Burkina Faso). Documents are French; English terms match only the English AI description. Most have OCR text and an AI description. Call with no arguments to list all.

keyword.description: Concept keyword; every word must occur in the title, OCR, French/English AI descriptions or subject; "quote" a phrase

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional). Corpus is mostly Burkina Faso/Togo/Benin

keyword.description: Return excerpts around matches instead of the full OCR (accent-insensitive)

tools.name: search_audiovisual
tools.description: Search audiovisual materials by keyword and metadata: francophone web video from Burkina Faso, Togo and Benin (TV reports, association and campus recordings), plus deposited Nigerian Hausa/Arabic recordings. Keyword matches title, creator, publisher, subject, spatial, language, source, the item's own description (the richest text most of these items have) and its transcription where one exists. Each row says which population it is from (`source_type`) and carries either `external_url` (a video to watch) or `media_url` (a file), never both.

keyword.description: Every word must occur across the title/metadata fields; "quote" a phrase

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional). Burkina Faso, Togo, Benin and Nigeria only — no Niger or Ivorian items

language.description: Exact language value, e.g. Français | Haoussa | Arabe | Anglais | Mooré

medium.description: Exact carrier medium: Vidéo sur le web | DVD | CD (validated, accents optional)

publisher.description: Substring on the publishing channel/broadcaster, e.g. RTB | AEEM | CERFI

source_type.description: youtube (harvested web video, the large majority) | deposited (recordings with a file, 47)

subject.description: Exact subject tag — only ~27 rows carry one, so prefer publisher/keyword

tools.name: list_audiovisual
tools.description: List audiovisual materials, newest first (francophone web video from Burkina Faso, Togo and Benin; deposited Nigerian Hausa/Arabic recordings). Filter by country, publishing channel or `source_type`.

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional). Burkina Faso, Togo, Benin and Nigeria only — no Niger or Ivorian items

publisher.description: Substring on the publishing channel/broadcaster, e.g. RTB | AEEM | CERFI

source_type.description: youtube (harvested web video, the large majority) | deposited (recordings with a file, 47)

tools.name: get_audiovisual
tools.description: Get one audiovisual record by id: full description and transcription (where one exists), creator/publishing channel, duration, medium, subjects, places, language, rights, source, and three distinct links: `url` (the IWAC page, the one to cite), `external_url` (where a harvested video plays) and `media_url` (a deposited file). `source_type` says which to expect. A long transcription comes in 25k-char parts (follow `next_offset`); `keyword` returns excerpts instead.

offset.description: Read from this character on: the previous part's next_offset

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search the IWAC photographs (30 items: mosques, radio stations, schools, signage and street scenes documented during fieldwork). Keyword matches title, creator, subject, place and the rare caption. Each result carries `image_url` (the full-resolution file), `coordinates` ('lat, lng' where known) and the canonical IWAC page. Call with no arguments to list all. Captions are almost never present, so prefer subject/place filters over keywords, or semantic_search_images when it is enabled.

keyword.description: French concept keyword; every word must occur in the title, creator, subject, place or caption; "quote" a phrase

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional)

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get one photograph by id: title, photographer, capture date, place and coordinates, subjects, rights, the IIIF manifest, and the full-resolution `image_url`. The server returns URLs, not image bytes.

tools.name: semantic_search_images
tools.description: Find photographs by describing what they SHOW, in any language ('mosquée en construction', 'street signage in Arabic'). This is cross-modal: the ranking runs against a multimodal embedding of the photograph itself, not against a caption, so it works even though only 2 of the 30 images have one. Runs the corpus model, EmbeddingGemma 2, locally with no API key (first use downloads ~350 MB). similarity_score only ranks within one query.

query.description: Description of the visual content, any language

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional)
